question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
SELECT 
    ci.db_year,
    c.primary_collision_factor,
    COUNT(*) as cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rank
FROM collisions c
JOIN case_ids ci ON c.case_id = ci.case_id
WHERE c.primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ci.db_year, c.primary_collision_factor
ORDER BY ci.db_year, cnt DESC
